WORTPAUSE — ANDROID INSTALLATION

1. Send Wortpause-Android-v1.0.apk to the Android phone.
2. Open the APK from Downloads, Files, WhatsApp, Telegram, or email.
3. If Android blocks it, tap Settings and allow “Install unknown apps” for the app you opened it from.
4. Return to the APK and tap Install.
5. Open Wortpause. All 813 cards and pronunciation files are included and work offline.

Android may display a warning because this is a privately shared app and is not downloaded from Google Play. Only install the APK received directly from Nir.

The app requires Android 7.0 or newer. Learning progress is stored only on that phone.
